blurb: Wonderlich Outdoors offers guided hunting and fishing trips including bow hunts, deer hunts, turkey hunts, upland bird hunts, duck and geese hunts, and fishing for largemouth bass and white bass. They provide gear, guides, and lodging options. Trips cover various Iowa public waters and private lands in Southeast Iowa.
extraNote: $50 deposit required · Cancellation fee applies if cancelled less than one week before trip · Tips are welcome · Trips operate weather permitting · Early Spring (April-October) through early Fall for open water fishing; December to early March for ice fishing
